_label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Invented to exercise the story code. NOT a recording, a certification of any product's capabilities, or a claim source. Never reuse as a captured result in a real film.
_note: authored, not run. An abstract opening is justified by a stated position (abstraction.justification) in a kind where abstraction is the point. Must ship, with a craft note (abstraction-justified), not a major issue.

treatment.treatment_title: One circle, built into a system
treatment.premise: explain the identity by building it from a single shape
treatment.logline: A circle is drawn, coloured, lettered and then used.
treatment.proposition: The new identity is one circle that behaves the same way everywhere.
treatment.viewer_takeaway: I can recognise the identity from the circle alone.
treatment.perspective: someone seeing the new identity for the first time

takeaways.text: the identity is built from one circle
the circle is used the same way in applications

optional_tools.purpose: the circle returns in every beat and develops

abstraction.justification: the film's position is that one simple shape is enough; the abstract opening states that position and the next beats show it applied

beats.viewer_takeaway: The circle takes one colour and one typeface and nothing else changes.

visual_event.before: an empty white frame with the plain circle
visual_event.change: colour fills the circle and the wordmark sets beside it
visual_event.after: the circle, the colour and the wordmark locked together

beats.viewer_takeaway: The same circle works on a poster, an app icon and a badge.

visual_event.change: the circle is placed on a poster, an app icon and a badge
visual_event.after: three applications that read as one identity

beats.viewer_takeaway: The identity is recognisable from the circle alone.

visual_event.before: the three applications side by side
visual_event.change: the applications recede until only the circle is left
visual_event.after: the circle alone on the brand colour
